text.tspan: Simulated outbreaks: the epinowcast generative model
Each outbreak gives a daily reporting triangle by stratum (count by onset day and report day), also summed to weeks, with the total over strata.
The reporting triangle as ragged series for Chronos-2
One block cut from a simulated release history
Each outbreak gives several weekly and daily blocks, each with
a random cut-off, delay D and set of places. Checkpoints are
trained on nested sets of simulated outbreaks.
LoRA: a frozen model, small trained adapters
